units metal
atom_style atomic
boundary p p p

# Read the equilibrated structure file

# Define interatomic potential

pair_coeff * * /results/2_AUGUST_2025/gpt_4o/tool_calling/melting/brief/subtasks/copper_potential_file_subtask_melting_trial_0/Cu_Zhou04.eam.alloy Cu

# Define settings
timestep 0.001

# NPT ensemble for heating
fix 1 all npt temp 300.0 2000.0 0.1 iso 0.0 0.0 1.0 drag 1.0
thermo 100
thermo_style custom step temp press vol density

# Run the simulation
run 20000

# Unfix the NPT ensemble
unfix 1

# Write the final configuration
write_data final_structure.data
"}
